text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that Hishi Amazon will be running in the Japan Cup, while Matikanetannhauser will be entering the autumn Tenno Sho taking place just before it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Compared to the impressive competition Narita Brian has faced in the past, people seem less worried. However, Narita Brian doesn't let her guard down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide admires how hard Brian is training. Yet, Narita Brian feels uncomfortable with how her older sister speaks so distantly, as if she is just a spectator.
